scenes.heading: Emotions fluctuate. And they add up.
scenes.visual_concept: Concept test for Chapter 3 (not in the doc yet).

beats.say: Emotions fluctuate, rising and falling throughout the day.
They also accumulate. Each experience can leave the water a little higher than before.
With enough time to recover, the level comes back down.

scenes.heading: Under, at, and over threshold
scenes.visual_concept: Concept test for Chapter 3 (not in the doc yet).

beats.say: The rim of the pot is your dog's threshold.
Under threshold, the water is warm but steady. Your dog notices, but can still think, eat, and learn.
At threshold, the bubbles rise toward the rim. Your dog stiffens, stares, and is slower to respond.
Over threshold, the pot boils over. Your dog reacts, and learning stops.

scenes.heading: Same heat, two pots
scenes.visual_concept: Concept test for Chapter 3 (not in the doc yet).

beats.say: Here's a pot with a low water level. When the heat comes on, the bubbles rise, but there's room. Nothing spills.
Now the same heat under a fuller pot. There's less room, so it boils over.

scenes.heading: Trigger stacking
scenes.visual_concept: Concept test for Chapter 3 (not in the doc yet).

beats.say: When triggers happen close together, the water doesn't have time to cool down.
Each one starts from a higher temperature, until something small tips it over. The last trigger gets the blame, even if it was the smallest.
Spread those same triggers out, and the water has time to cool in between.

scenes.heading: Before, during, and after training
scenes.visual_concept: Concept test for Chapter 3 (not in the doc yet).

beats.say: Before training, the pot is full, the trigger turns the heat up high, and it boils over.
During training, we lower the water. We turn the heat down with distance and management. And we teach new skills while the bubbles stay low.
After training, your dog turns the heat down on their own. The bubbles rise a little, stay in the pot, and settle quickly. A dog with a better plan.
